name: BF Plumbing & Drain, Inc.
blurb: BF Plumbing & Drain, Inc. is a family-owned plumbing company based in Woodstock, serving nearby communities across Metro Atlanta. Its residential services include water heater work, sewer and water line repairs or replacements, drain cleaning, pressure troubleshooting, pipe replacement, and fixture installation. The company states that it is licensed and insured and has 25 years of hands-on experience.
